misconceptions.title: Squared each term separately
misconceptions.titleFil: Hiwalay na sinquare ang bawat term
misconceptions.what: You wrote $(a+b)^2$ as $a^2 + b^2$. Squaring a sum also makes a middle term, $2ab$.
misconceptions.whatFil: Isinulat mo ang $(a+b)^2$ bilang $a^2 + b^2$. Kapag sinquare ang sum, may middle term din: $2ab$.

misconceptions.title: Multiplied only the first term
misconceptions.what: The number outside the parentheses has to multiply every term inside, not just the first one.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang numero sa labas ng parentheses ay dapat i-multiply sa lahat ng term sa loob, hindi lang sa una.

misconceptions.title: Lost a sign when distributing a negative
misconceptions.titleFil: Nawala ang sign sa pag-distribute ng negative
misconceptions.what: A negative outside the parentheses changes the sign of every term inside.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang negative sa labas ng parentheses ay nagpapalit ng sign ng bawat term sa loob.

misconceptions.title: Moved a term without changing its sign
misconceptions.titleFil: Inilipat ang term nang hindi pinalitan ang sign
misconceptions.what: Moving a term to the other side means doing the opposite operation to both sides, so its sign flips.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang paglipat ng term sa kabilang side ay paggawa ng kabaligtarang operasyon sa magkabilang side, kaya nagpapalit ang sign nito.

misconceptions.title: Divided only part of the equation
misconceptions.titleFil: Bahagi lang ng equation ang na-divide
misconceptions.what: When you divide, every term on both sides has to be divided by the same number.
misconceptions.whatFil: Kapag nag-divide, lahat ng term sa magkabilang side ay dapat i-divide sa parehong numero.

misconceptions.title: Subtracted the coefficient instead of dividing
misconceptions.titleFil: Ibinawas ang coefficient sa halip na i-divide
misconceptions.what: $3x$ means $3 \times x$, so you undo it by dividing by 3, not subtracting 3.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang $3x$ ay $3 \times x$, kaya i-divide sa 3 para alisin ito, hindi ibawas ang 3.

misconceptions.title: Added fractions straight across
misconceptions.titleFil: Diretsong pinagsama ang numerator at denominator
misconceptions.what: $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3}$ isn't $\frac{2}{5}$. Fractions need a common denominator before you add.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3}$ ay hindi $\frac{2}{5}$. Kailangan ng common denominator bago mag-add.

misconceptions.title: Combined unlike terms
misconceptions.titleFil: Pinagsama ang hindi magkatulad na term
misconceptions.what: $2x$ and $3$ aren't like terms, so they can't be added into $5x$.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang $2x$ at $3$ ay hindi like terms, kaya hindi sila puwedeng gawing $5x$.

misconceptions.title: Multiplied the variable when adding
misconceptions.what: $2x + 3x = 5x$. Adding like terms adds the numbers; the variable stays the same.
misconceptions.whatFil: $2x + 3x = 5x$. Sa pag-add ng like terms, ang numero lang ang pinagsasama; hindi nagbabago ang variable.

misconceptions.title: Mixed up the exponent rules
misconceptions.titleFil: Nagkapalit ang mga batas ng exponent
misconceptions.what: Multiplying powers adds exponents: $x^2 \cdot x^3 = x^5$. A power of a power multiplies them: $(x^2)^3 = x^6$.
misconceptions.whatFil: Sa pag-multiply ng powers, ina-add ang exponents: $x^2 \cdot x^3 = x^5$. Sa power ng power, mina-multiply: $(x^2)^3 = x^6$.

misconceptions.title: Took the square root of each term
misconceptions.titleFil: Kinuha ang square root ng bawat term
misconceptions.what: $\sqrt{x^2 + 9}$ is not $x + 3$. Square roots don't split across addition.
misconceptions.whatFil: Ang $\sqrt{x^2 + 9}$ ay hindi $x + 3$. Hindi puwedeng hatiin ang square root sa addition.

misconceptions.title: Halved instead of taking the square root
misconceptions.titleFil: Hinati sa dalawa sa halip na kunin ang square root
misconceptions.what: Undoing $x^2$ means taking the square root, not dividing by 2.
misconceptions.whatFil: Para alisin ang $x^2$, kunin ang square root, hindi i-divide sa 2.

misconceptions.title: Forgot the negative square root
misconceptions.titleFil: Nakalimutan ang negative na square root
misconceptions.what: Both $7^2$ and $(-7)^2$ equal 49, so taking a square root gives two answers: $\pm$.
misconceptions.whatFil: Parehong 49 ang $7^2$ at $(-7)^2$, kaya dalawa ang sagot sa square root: $\pm$.

misconceptions.title: Divided by the variable and lost a solution
misconceptions.titleFil: Nag-divide sa variable at nawala ang isang sagot
misconceptions.what: Dividing both sides by $x$ throws away $x = 0$. Move everything to one side and factor instead.
misconceptions.whatFil: Kapag nag-divide sa $x$, nawawala ang $x = 0$. Ilipat lahat sa isang side at i-factor.

misconceptions.title: Lost a solution
misconceptions.what: This step dropped one of the equation's solutions.
misconceptions.whatFil: Sa step na ito, may nawalang isang sagot ng equation.
